title: The Great Rodriguez
text: Had lots of fun doing the Kayak tour. Learned a lot about the history of Seville from our amazing tour guide Rodriguez (very funny guy btw!!!) Also the girl in the reception was very helpful with any questions we had and was extremely welcoming! Great relaxing way to end the holiday 😁
author: LewyWalsh

title: Excellent
text: A good activity to do I really loved. The guide Jose was super friendly and explained the history of Seville very well.
author: Sibel S

title: Fabulous time in the canal
text:
Amazing time by all the family !
We had so much fun . Our guide was amazing and we were grateful to cool down in the river :)
